recognize_zh: 數顆漿細胞的細胞質被大量圓形、淡藍到深藍的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies）塞滿，看起來像一串葡萄，核被推擠到一側，這是 Mott cell（葡萄細胞）的典型外觀。
features: Plasma cells with cytoplasm packed by numerous round, variably sized globular inclusions (Russell bodies)
Globules range from pale blue to deeply basophilic, giving a grape-cluster (Mott cell) appearance
Round to slightly irregular eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, partly obscured by the globules
One binucleate/indented nucleus in a Mott cell
Background red cells with a few platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous round, variably sized pale to deep blue globular inclusions, consistent with Russell bodies forming Mott (grape) cells. The nuclei are eccentric with clumped chromatin and are partly obscured by the inclusions, and one cell has an indented or bilobed nucleus. These inclusions represent accumulated immunoglobulin within dilated endoplasmic reticulum. Mott cells can be seen in both reactive plasmacytosis and plasma cell neoplasms; clonality should be assessed by kappa/lambda studies and correlated with the overall plasma cell burden.

ddx.vs: Storage histiocytes have small central nuclei and granular or foamy cytoplasm with lipid material, lacking immunoglobulin globules and plasma cell nuclear features.
Basophil and mast cell granules are small, uniform, dark purple-black and metachromatic, not large pale blue globules.
Burkitt cells have clear lipid vacuoles in deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a high N:C ratio, rather than solid immunoglobulin globules in mature plasma cells.
